The '''Detainment Center''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The Imperial Detainment Center was an holding facility for political prisoners built by the Galactic Empire in an isolated area of the Talus mountains. The detainment center was a large underground facility with small cells and holding pens for prisoners. Many Imperial officers worked here, along with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and prison guards.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Imperial Detainment Center had become a contested hotspot in the Galactic Civil War and Imperial and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] forces fought several times for the control of the prison. The Rebel Alliance attacked the facility and temporarily took control of it. But the fight between the Empire and rebels over the control of this institute continued. The Empire eventually succeeded, forcing the rebels to retreat.<ref name="SWG:DC" /> Around the same time, a spacer managed to infiltrate the prison and stole a piece of [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWG:LISTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Imperial Shock Trooper Armor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Detainment Center was a [[:w:c:swg:Point of interest|Point of Interest]] in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. A [[:w:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] pointing to this location is included in every player's datapad.<ref name="SWG:DC" /> The Detainment Center was intended to be a "Factional NPC Base". Groups of Rebel players could attack Imperial NPCs and achieve several objectives to take control of the base.<ref name="StW">{{SonyCite|url=manual_detail.jsp?id=58143|text=Swaying the War}}</ref> It was originally intended that players could use terminals inside the facility to gain control of the prison for their faction. However, this functionality was broken very early on and has never been fixed. Since then, the detainment center was populated with Imperial NPCs.

A copy of this facility was later used for the [[Detainment Facility|Imperial Detainment Facility]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]]/[[Remembrance Day]] events of 2009 to 2011.<ref name="SWG:GU17">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Game Update 17: Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII</ref>
